A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for replacement of the Robert Street viaduct in the city of St. Paul if federal funding is rescinded.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ROBERT STREET VIADUCT REPLACEMENT; CONTINGENT APPROPRIATIONS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Definitions.+]

[+(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given. +]

[+(b) "Project" means the replacement of the viaduct and associated reconstruction projects in the area, including but not limited to reconstruction of Robert Street from Page Street to Cesar Chavez Street, updating pedestrian crossings, improving sidewalks and trails, improving transit access, improving lighting, and providing additional community-desired amenities. +]

[+(c) "RAISE grant" means the $25,000,000 Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity grant awarded to the Department of Transportation by USDOT in January 2025 to complete the project. +]

[+(d) "USDOT" means the United States Department of Transportation. +]

[+(e) "Viaduct" means the George Street bridge and adjacent retaining walls over Robert Street in the city of St. Paul. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Trunk highway fund; appropriation.+]

[+If the RAISE grant is rescinded by USDOT, $21,200,000 is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner of transportation to complete the portions of the project eligible for the use of trunk highway funds. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed. +]

[+Subd. 3.+]

[+General fund; appropriation.+]

[+If the RAISE grant is rescinded by USDOT, $3,800,000 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation to complete the portions of the project ineligible for the use of trunk highway funds. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for replacement of the Robert Street viaduct in the city of St. Paul if federal funding is rescinded.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ROBERT STREET VIADUCT REPLACEMENT; CONTINGENT APPROPRIATIONS.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.

(b) "Project" means the replacement of the viaduct and associated reconstruction projects in the area, including but not limited to reconstruction of Robert Street from Page Street to Cesar Chavez Street, updating pedestrian crossings, improving sidewalks and trails, improving transit access, improving lighting, and providing additional community-desired amenities.

(c) "RAISE grant" means the $25,000,000 Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity grant awarded to the Department of Transportation by USDOT in January 2025 to complete the project.

(d) "USDOT" means the United States Department of Transportation.

(e) "Viaduct" means the George Street bridge and adjacent retaining walls over Robert Street in the city of St. Paul.

Subd. 2.

Trunk highway fund; appropriation.

If the RAISE grant is rescinded by USDOT, $21,200,000 is appropriated from the trunk highway fund to the commissioner of transportation to complete the portions of the project eligible for the use of trunk highway funds. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed.

Subd. 3.

General fund; appropriation.

If the RAISE grant is rescinded by USDOT, $3,800,000 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation to complete the portions of the project ineligible for the use of trunk highway funds. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
